description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering detailed project activity reports within the OrangeHRM time plugin. It extends a base report filter class and adds a specific property for project activity ID, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDetailedReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering detailed project activity reports, allowing filtering by project activity ID and setting default sort field.

methods.name: getProjectActivityId
methods.description: Returns the project activity ID used for filtering, or null if not set.

methods.name: setProjectActivityId
methods.description: Sets the project activity ID for filtering.
